title: Consolidate prioritized planning evidence against main
instruction: Transcribed from Sato Kento's instruction to proceed with the five highest-priority OpenFS tasks. Consolidate the pending research onto a branch based directly on main; verify the production Pages workflow separately from preview builds; improve public evidence for HPCI system operation, procurement and five-year cost readiness, and EEA1 application-performance reproducibility; expose the resulting provisional evidence on GitHub Pages; validate it; and create a bilingual pull request against main. Do not infer missing values, do not convert annual contracts into a five-year TCO, keep Coverage Gaps explicit, and keep Consensus incomplete because this work uses one model and one agent. This directive authorizes publication preparation and a pull request, but not merging the pull request or treating the content as a procurement recommendation.
